body.name: Complete \((2,2,3)\) source-table trace
body.construction: Take the ordered cycle \(1\to2\to3\to1\), \(\mathcal X_1=\mathcal X_2=\{0,1\}\), \(\mathcal X_3=\{0,1,2\}\), and sources \(s_{12},s_{23},e_2\) with incidences \(\{1,2\},\{2,3\},\{2\}\). Enumerate the eight maps \(i:\mathcal X_3\to\mathcal X_1\), four maps \(j:\mathcal X_1\to\mathcal X_2\), and nine maps \(k:\mathcal X_2\to\mathcal X_3\) lexicographically. The legality checker retains exactly the 240 triples for which \(k\circ j\circ i\) has one fixed point and rejects 48. The source interface is \(\pi_{ijk}=a_i c_k b_{j\mid ik}\), with \(a,c\) simplex blocks for \(s_{12},s_{23}\), \(b_{\cdot\mid ik}\) a private-source conditional simplex supported only on retained triples, and boundary rows \(u_a=\sum_i a_i\mathbf1\{i(a)=1\}\) and \(v_b=\sum_k c_k\mathbf1\{k(b)=2\}\). Supply clamp regimes \(\operatorname{do}(X_3=a)\) for \(a=0,1,2\) and \(\operatorname{do}(X_2=b)\) for \(b=0,1\). For each of the four queries \(A_{ab}=\{X_1(X_3=a)=1,X_3(X_2=b)=2\}\), \(a,b\in\{0,1\}\), with \(B\) the sure event, the ordered recursion takes transitions (1), (2), (3), and (6), and \(\mathsf{SATerm}\) returns \(C_{ab}(p)=u_av_b\). Its checker record is \(\mathsf{VALID\_INPUT};\mathsf{LEGAL}=240/288;\mathsf{SOURCES}=(8,9,4\text{ conditional states});\mathsf{SEPARATOR\_QE}=\mathsf{UNSAT};\mathsf{REMAINDER}=0;\mathsf{DIVISOR}=1;\mathsf{INTERFACE}=\mathsf{MATCH};\mathsf{OUTPUT}=u_av_b\). Thus the trace exposes the source-table product interface rather than treating the 240 legal rows as one unrestricted simplex.
